name: Delete Task
description: The user permanently removes a task from the list by clicking the delete button on it. The deletion cannot be undone.
preconditions: The Task List screen is visible
At least one task exists in the list

main_flow.description: Clicks the delete button on a task
Permanently removes the task from the list

alternative_flows.name: Delete fails
alternative_flows.trigger: At step 2, the deletion cannot be completed

postconditions: The task is permanently removed from the list
business_rules: Deletion is permanent — there is no undo or recovery option

bdd_scenarios.given: The user is on the Task List screen and at least one task exists
bdd_scenarios.when: The user clicks the delete button on a task
bdd_scenarios.then: The task is permanently removed from the list and a success notification is shown

bdd_scenarios.given: The user is on the Task List screen and at least one task exists
bdd_scenarios.when: The user clicks the delete button but the deletion cannot be completed
bdd_scenarios.then: An error notification is displayed and the task remains in the list
